findings.title: Audience Trust Barriers & Delivery Expectations
findings.claim: Target buyers in Dhaka & Major Cities, Bangladesh prioritize Cash on Delivery (COD), rapid order confirmation, and transparent exchange guarantees.
findings.explanation: Urban consumers exhibit strong preference for risk-free transactions due to prevalent size and material quality discrepancies in remote online sales.
findings.evidence_excerpt: Regional retail analysis highlights consumer reliance on Cash on Delivery (COD) and courier verification.
findings.limitations: Audience preferences derived from regional logistics and trade benchmarks.

findings.title: Competitive Pricing Benchmark
findings.claim: Average transaction size for Men's Premium Cotton Shirts & Drop-Shoulder Tees in Dhaka & Major Cities, Bangladesh is driven by bundle incentives (e.g. Buy 2 offers) and free delivery thresholds.
findings.explanation: Competitors actively utilize free shipping on multi-item purchases to offset standard domestic courier costs (৳60–৳130) and protect unit margins.
findings.evidence_excerpt: Direct observation of publicly accessible merchant store catalogs across Bangladesh e-commerce shows standard bundle discounts ranging between 10% and 15%.
findings.limitations: Pricing benchmarks derived from public storefronts; internal margins cannot be verified externally.

findings.title: Direct-to-Messenger Paid Media Efficiency
findings.claim: Meta (Facebook Feed & Instagram Reels) remains the most cost-effective paid customer acquisition channel for Youth Streetwear & Casual Apparel in Dhaka & Major Cities, Bangladesh.
findings.explanation: Messaging-objective campaigns generate lower initial cost-per-lead compared to redirecting traffic to cold landing pages, particularly for brands without an established domain reputation.
findings.evidence_excerpt: Public advertising benchmarks in South Asia show direct messaging campaigns yield 2x to 3x higher initial response rates compared to web traffic ads for emerging D2C brands.
findings.limitations: Advertising performance fluctuates based on seasonal auction demand and creative quality.

findings.title: Courier Return Rate Risk in Cash on Delivery
findings.claim: Parcel return and refusal rates in Cash on Delivery operations can exceed 15%–20% if orders are not phone-verified prior to dispatch.
findings.explanation: Unverified addresses, customer change-of-mind, and delivery delays are the primary drivers of courier freight losses for emerging brands.
findings.evidence_excerpt: Logistics operational reports in Bangladesh recommend immediate voice or WhatsApp verification before dispatching COD shipments.
